resolved.title: C语言介绍
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Introducing C[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]C[/b] is a general-purpose programming language that has been around for nearly 50 years. 
[b]C[/b] has been used to write everything from operating systems (including Windows and many others) to complex programs like the Python interpreter, Git, Oracle database, and more. 
The versatility of C is by design. It is a low-level language that relates closely to the way machines work while still being easy to learn. 
[note]Understanding how computer memory works is an important aspect of the C programming language. [/note]

content.text:
**C**是一种通用的编程语言，已有近50年的历史。
**C**可以编写从操作系统（包括Windows和其他许多系统）到复杂的程序，如Python解释器、Git、Oracle数据库等。

C的功能性是设计出来的。它是一种**低级别**的语言，与机器的工作方式密切相关，同时也易于学习。
content.text_html:
C is a general-purpose programming language that has been around for nearly 50 years. C has been used to write everything from operating systems (including Windows and many others) to complex programs like the Python interpreter, Git, Oracle database, and more. The versatility of C is by design. It is a low-level language that relates closely to the way machines work while still being easy to learn.

C是一种通用的编程语言，已经有近50年的历史。 C已经被用来编写从操作系统（包括Windows和其他许多系统）到复杂的程序，如Python解释器、Git、Oracle数据库等。 C的多功能性是设计出来的。它是一种低级别的语言，与机器的工作方式密切相关，同时也很容易学习。

content.text: 学习C语言，可以帮助大家更深入理解计算机底层的工作原理，如内存管理。
content.text_html:
Understanding how computer memory works is an important aspect of the C programming language.

了解计算机内存如何工作是C语言编程的一个重要方面。
